entries.description: A field of a data composition source. It is the same kind of value as CompositionField: a path, and a presentation when one was given. A filter, a sort and a conditional appearance point at one of these. The presentation may be omitted.
entries.parameters: path — the field, such as "Amount" or "Supplier.Region". presentation — the words shown instead of the path. May be omitted.
entries.example:
field = New DataCompositionField("Amount");
alias = New CompositionField("Amount", "Sum");

entries.description: A field of a data composition source. New CompositionField(path, presentation) keeps the path and an optional presentation. DataCompositionField is the same value under the name ported code already uses.
entries.parameters: path — the field. presentation — optional words shown instead of the path.
